General relativity, Einstein's next major discovery, fits squarely within this march toward theories with ever greater symmetry. Just as you can think of special relativity as establishing symmetry among all observers moving relative to one another with constant velocity, you can think of general relativity as going one step farther and establishing symmetry among all accelerated vantage points as well.
